mechanism_comparison.standard_algebra: For coordinate pairs (d_1,H_1) and (d_2,H_2), the cross-defect d_1H_2-d_2H_1 is their 2x2 determinant. Substituting d_i=k_iM_i-BF_i and H_i=S_iM_i and collecting B-divisible terms gives the displayed identity immediately.
mechanism_comparison.local_consumer: Reduced carries produced by one rational candidate must be projectively coherent modulo B; a nonzero determinant residue excludes that denominator.
mechanism_comparison.failed_producer: The proposed producer tried to force useful residues through the uniform estimate |cent(Q mod B)|<=B/4.
mechanism_comparison.exact_retirement: The pinned B=7 actual-window witness has centered quotient residue -2, outside the quarter band, while retaining nonzero projective residue. Therefore the inequality is false and the modular consumer remains useful.
